_note: WHAT YOU DO FOR CLIENTS — the six service cards, plus the Services page.
Add or remove an entry in `items` and it updates the home page grid, the
Services page, the footer menu and the dropdown on the contact form, all
`id` is the short name used in web addresses (lower case, dashes instead
of spaces). Changing it changes the link to that service.

seo.title: Services
seo.description: Product engineering, AI engineering, cloud and DevOps, design systems, data platforms, and security engineering — delivered by senior squads in two-week sprints.

hero.title: Senior squads, embedded in your roadmap.
hero.description: We staff a cross-functional team from six disciplines and work in your repo, on your infra, at your cadence. No junior bench, no handoff to a delivery manager you've never met.

closing._note: The big invitation band at the bottom of the Services page.
closing.title: Let's scope the first sprint.
closing.description: Bring the problem, the constraints, and the deadline. We'll come back with an architecture, a plan, and a fixed price.

_note: The heading above the six cards on the home page. `titleMuted` is the
greyed-out second half of the sentence.

heading.title: Six disciplines,
heading.description: We staff a squad from these, not a department per line item. Most engagements pull from three or four at once.

_note: `icon` picks the small symbol on the card. See the list of allowed
icon names at the bottom of content/README.md.
`deliverables` only appear on the Services page, not the home page.
`stack` are the little tags along the bottom of the card.
items.title: Product Engineering
items.blurb: Zero-to-one builds and rescue missions. We own the whole surface — architecture, API, interface, release — and hand you a codebase your team will actually enjoy inheriting.

items.title: AI Engineering
items.blurb: Applied AI that survives production. Retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, evals, guardrails — built with the same rigour we give payment systems.

items.title: Cloud & DevOps
items.blurb: Infrastructure as a product. Reproducible environments, sane pipelines, and observability that tells you what broke before your users do.

items.title: Design & Systems
items.blurb: Interfaces with intent. We design in code, ship tokenised component libraries, and leave you a system instead of a pile of screens.

items.title: Data Platforms
items.blurb: From event to insight. Warehouses, streams, and contracts that keep analytics trustworthy as your product multiplies.

items.title: Security Engineering
items.blurb: Threat modelling, hardening, and audit prep. We break it on purpose so nobody else gets the chance, then leave the controls documented.
